subject: Next steps: deep-dive demo & procurement path
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: deep-dive demo & procurement path

Alex —

Great to connect today. Thanks for the detailed run-through of Acme's platform goals and your latency/cost constraints. Per our call, I captured a few quick bullets and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary use case is multi-tenant summary + guided Q&A; target p50 token latency < 150ms for 1K concurrent users.
- Concrete asks from your side: security questionnaire, procurement vendor packet, and an architecture review with your platform team.
- Proposed next meeting: a technical deep-dive / demo (45–60m) where Marissa walks through the real-time inference flow and Dev can cover security integration patterns.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2027-04-14 09:00–10:00
- Thu 2027-04-15 11:00–12:00
- Fri 2027-04-16 13:00–14:00

Agenda (draft):
1) 5m — goals and success criteria (Alex)
2) 25m — demo + perf profile (Marissa)
3) 15m — security/infra integration Q&A (Dev)
4) 10m — procurement/next steps and timeline (Sean)

I attached a short discovery-notes.pdf for your reference. If you prefer different times or want us to loop in any additional folks (security lead, procurement contact), say the word and I'll reschedule.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cloudops.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: deep-dive demo & procurement path

Thanks Sean — that summary is perfect. I ran the proposed times by the team. A couple notes: 

- Please loop in someone from your security team (we have a short vendor security checklist and would like to run through your approach to KV cache encryption and key management).
- I'm adding Priya (CloudOps) in cc — she'll coordinate with our infra and ops leads.
- Procurement will need a vendor packet; I'll forward the procurement contact separately.

The Thu 2027-04-15 11:00 slot looks the cleanest for us. Can Marissa and Dev do that?

Appreciate the quick follow-up.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product, Acme Corporation
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com

Alex / Acme procurement —

Thanks for the heads up, Alex. Thu 2027-04-15 11:00–12:00 PST works for Marissa and Dev; I've tentatively reserved the slot on our calendar. Marissa will demo the latency/cost tradeoffs and available model variants; Dev will cover integration hooks (VPC & KMS notes).

Procurement team — can you share any vendor questionnaire or portal link ahead of the meeting? If you prefer, we can provide a short vendor packet + preliminary SOW after the demo. I've attached a one-page discovery summary for quick context.

Pre-demo asks (we'll keep this light):
- A copy of your standard vendor security checklist or a link to the portal
- Any scoring criteria for SOW/PO approval (timeline, pilot length, pricing thresholds)

If Thu doesn't work, alternate is Wed 09:00 PST.

Cheers,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cloudops.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: deep-dive demo & procurement path

Hi Sean —

Thanks for reaching out. Thu 04/15 11:00 PST works for our side. Attaching our vendor-forms.docx (standard packet) — please complete sections A and B and upload to the vendor portal prior to contract review. Our initial procurement checklist is: corporate vendor packet, preliminary SOW, and pricing range (ballpark ok).

Portal link: https://acmecorp.vendor-portal.example/submit

We'd also like a short SOW draft ahead of the meeting if possible (1–2 pages) and any commitments on support SLAs for pilot customers. If you can send a PDF SOW-draft and a ballpark pricing range, that will help accelerate internal review.

Thanks — talk soon.

Procurement Team
procurement@acmecorp.com
